facts_found: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

A referrer can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window across all checking account types; additional referrals in that window are automatically denied. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referred person or business must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

For business accounts, the referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

Referrer tenure thresholds vary by referral program and are measured from the date the referrer opened their earliest Rho-Bank checking account; the referrer's current account type does not need to match the referred account type. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The qualifying deposit must be new money brought into Rho-Bank and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]
The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed, and both accounts must remain in good standing for bonuses to be retained. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses, and only one referral code can be applied per new account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The deposit window for qualifying referrals varies by account type, typically between 60 and 120 days. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]

Navy Blue business checking referral pays the referrer $100 and the referred business $75, with a maximum of 10 referrals per year, requiring a $5,000 qualifying deposit within 90 days and 60 days of referrer checking tenure. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_001]

Cobalt Blue business checking referral requires the referred business to deposit at least $7,500 within 90 days and requires the referrer's earliest checking account to be at least 60 days old; the retrieved Cobalt Blue document does not state the referrer bonus amount or annual cap. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_005]

Sky Blue is a startup business checking account for companies within 4 years of formation, with a funding requirement of 0, and its referral program pays the referrer $150 and the referred startup $250, with an annual limit of 8 referrals; the retrieved Sky Blue document does not state the referral qualifying deposit or referrer tenure requirement. [doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_001]

Lime Green business checking referral pays the referrer $200 and the referred business $150, with an annual cap of 12 referrals, requiring the referred business to deposit $15,000 within 90 days and the referrer to have maintained checking account status for at least 90 days. [doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_003]

World Blue business checking referral pays the referrer $300 and the referred business $200, with an annual limit of 12 referral bonuses, and bonuses are typically credited within 7-10 business days of qualification. [doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_007]

World Blue referral eligibility requires the referrer to have maintained checking account status for at least 90 days, and the referred business must open World Blue and deposit at least $25,000 within 90 days. [doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_001]

True Blue business checking referral pays the referrer $350 and the referred business $250, with a maximum of 15 referrals per year, requiring a $50,000 qualifying deposit within 120 days and 90 days of referrer checking tenure. [doc_business_checking_accounts_true_blue_002]

Beige business checking referral pays the referrer $500 and the referred enterprise $350, with a maximum of 15 referrals per year, requiring a $100,000 qualifying deposit within 120 days and 120 days of referrer checking tenure. [doc_business_checking_accounts_beige_012]
For Beige referrals, the referrer contacts a dedicated relationship manager for referral materials and tracking. [doc_business_checking_accounts_beige_012]
For Lime Green referrals, the referrer can speak with a dedicated account manager for personalized referral strategies and tracking. [doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_003]

Referral statuses include NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, REJECTED, and ERROR, and referrals should be tracked until qualification is confirmed. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]

An active November 2025 internal promotion directs agents to prioritize Sky Blue first and Lime Green second when recommending business checking accounts, if multiple accounts meet the customer's stated requirements. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_013]

facts_found: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

A referrer can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window across all checking account types; additional referrals in that window are automatically denied. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referred person or business must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

For business accounts, the referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

Referrer tenure thresholds vary by referral program and are measured from the date the referrer opened their earliest Rho-Bank checking account; the referrer's current account type does not need to match the referred account type. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The qualifying deposit must be new money brought into Rho-Bank and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]
The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]

If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed, and both accounts must remain in good standing for bonuses to be retained. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses, and only one referral code can be applied per new account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047]
The deposit window for qualifying referrals varies by account type, typically between 60 and 120 days. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_048]
